title: Vendor due diligence
description: Before buying software, data or services: classify the vendor, run the checks its criticality requires, sign the right terms and plan the exit.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1, Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations
NCSC, Principles of supply chain security
ENISA, Good Practices for Supply Chain Cybersecurity (2023)

rules.instruction: Classify the vendor by the data it receives, the access it gets and the service that depends on it, and record the reason.
rules.verification: Open the vendor record and check the criticality and its reason.

rules.instruction: For a vendor that handles company or customer data, read its security questionnaire and certification report, including the scope, period and exceptions.
rules.verification: Check that the vendor record links the questionnaire and report with their dates and lists the exceptions found.

rules.instruction: Sign a data processing agreement and record the subprocessors and data locations when the vendor processes personal data for the company.
rules.verification: Check that the vendor record links the signed agreement and the subprocessor list.

rules.instruction: Enter the renewal date and notice period of the contract in the team calendar with an owner.
rules.verification: Check the calendar entry, its owner and the date the notice must be sent.

rules.instruction: For a critical vendor, write the exit plan: data export format, transition period, alternative and time to switch, and test the export.
rules.verification: Open the exit plan and check its four parts and the date of the last export test.
